subject: [new package] shinyjs: perform common JavaScript operations in Shiny apps using plain R code

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: [new package] shinyjs: perform common JavaScript operations in Shiny apps using plain R code
parts:
https://github.com/daattali/shinyjs

I made a package that I want to share with Shiny app devs.  The package exposes some common useful (at least in my opinion, stuff that I use often) JS functions in R, and abstracts away the JS to make it easier to do some simple things that basic Shiny doesn't readily support. I use it in most of my shiny apps for doing stuff like showing/hiding elements, changing the HTML of an element, showing alert message, nothing too fancy.

I hope others will find it useful
